methodology.description: Agency measured across 10 dimensions: autonomous planning, tool selection, self-verification, error recovery, durable execution, authorization gating, auditability, learning/adaptation, determinism/replay, laziness detection.
data_sources: codebase analysis (grep for self-healing, gates, effect taxonomy)
methodology.scoring: Per-dimension 0-1 score, weighted composite. Weights calibrated by architectural significance.

autonomous_planning.description: Can decompose a goal into steps and execute without re-prompting

grok.evidence: Goal mode with update_goal tool, planner→execute→verify→judge→settle pipeline

tool_selection.description: Can select the right tool for a job with calibrated confidence

grok.evidence: Tool calling via function definitions; no EBM energy ranking, no confidence calibration per tool

self_verification.description: Can check its own work against a falsifiable acceptance criterion

grok.evidence: Can self-review but no falsifiable gate; verification is prose-based, not mechanical

error_recovery.description: Can detect, classify, and recover from failures without human intervention

grok.evidence: Retry on failure; doom-loop recovery present; no structured self-healing taxonomy

durable_execution.description: Can persist state and resume across interruptions

grok.evidence: Session JSONL persistence; torn-line self-healing; no contract ledger or deterministic replay

authorization_gating.description: Has a real permission model that gates consequential effects

grok.evidence: Tool-level permissions; no typed effect classes; no ContractAuthorized/Hold gating

auditability.description: Every decision is traceable to its stimulus, sources, and evidence

grok.evidence: Session transcripts preserved; no W6H enforcement; no cryptographic occurrence IDs

learning_adaptation.description: Improves tool selection from experience; caches proven routes

grok.evidence: No per-tool success/failure tracking; no energy scores; no growth ledger for experiments

determinism_replay.description: Can reproduce results deterministically from the ledger

evidence.architectural_constraint: Producers on recompute path must be deterministic

grok.evidence: LLM sampling is non-deterministic by design; no replay mechanism
LazinessDetector with 10s idle threshold, doom-loop recovery, task completion discipline
